source_title: Comparative efficacy and safety of SGLT2 inhibitor class members in patients with heart failure and type 2 diabetes: A systematic review and network meta-analysis of randomized controlled trials
schema_gaps: No dedicated systematic_review_result/meta_analysis_result/network_meta_analysis_result atom kinds; existing quantitative_result/adverse_event/subgroup_result kinds were used with explicit secondary-source tags.
extraction_limitations: This is a secondary systematic review/NMA; atoms represent claims and pooled estimates reported by the review, not direct patient-level observations generated by Su et al.

The supplied supplement is a large DOCX with 74 supplementary figure objects and 11 named league/heterogeneity tables; only load-bearing quantitative findings were atomized individually while all visuals were reconciled in the coverage manifest and SEA.
Internal source inconsistencies were preserved rather than silently harmonized.
